Imagine… your heart beats for the very last time.
What happens next depends on one choice.
Buried… or burned.
Your body starts to cool.
About one and a half degrees every hour.
A few hours later, your muscles lock up.
Rigor mortis.
Option one.
They lower you six feet into the cold earth.
Then.
The lid goes dark.
And trillions of your own bacteria wake up.
After about ten years in a coffin, only your skeleton is left.
And your bones… can last for centuries.
Option two.
Fire.
The chamber reaches up to one thousand eight hundred degrees Fahrenheit.
In about two hours, everything soft… is gone.
What's left is around five pounds of bone, ground into ash.
But… here is the strange part.
Your ashes can be pressed into a real diamond.
And in nineteen ninety-seven, the creator of Star Trek had his ashes launched into space.
So remember.
Six feet of earth… or five pounds of ash.
Which one would you choose?
